name: The Indian Gypsy Children Home
appeal: A stronger home for 15 growing boys.
story: Bhukya Dhanpal and his wife maintain this home with limited external support, relying largely on local help and individual supporters. The boys live in small rooms in a tin/metal-sheet structure, with three washrooms serving the home.
need: Help provide safe drinking water, everyday household equipment, storage, and resources for learning and play. Together, we can make daily life better for the children who call this place home.
needs: Washing machine, mixer/grinder and kitchen equipment
Computers, educational resources, sports and recreation
budgetNote: Item-wise costs and allocations will be confirmed before procurement. Support for the new building is subject to verification of construction documents and funding requirements.
